name: Covariate-moderated empirical Bayes matrix factorization
model_likelihood: Z=L F^T+E; Gaussian residuals with precision tau_ij
prior: Factor-specific loading and factor prior families parameterized by row and column covariates
inference_algorithm: Mean-field variational empirical Bayes; block coordinate ascent via cEBNM subproblems
estimand: Posterior first and second moments of L and F and learned factor priors
data_input: Matrix Z with optional missing entries and row and/or column side information X and Y
tunable_settings: Factor count K or upper bound; prior families and their covariate parameterizations; initialization; residual-variance structure; ELBO stopping tolerance; iteration cap

name: Covariate-moderated empirical Bayes normal means
model_likelihood: Independent Gaussian noisy means with known positive standard deviations
prior: Independent covariate-dependent priors g(d_i,theta) in a specified family G
inference_algorithm: Marginal-likelihood estimation of theta followed by posterior computation
estimand: Fitted prior parameters and posterior distributions; first and second moments suffice for cEBMF
data_input: Noisy estimates beta_hat, standard deviations s and covariate matrix D
tunable_settings: Prior family G and its parameterization
